content.text:
I couldn't find any information about boardflight.app. My searches only turned up boardflight.com, so I can't say whether the two domains are related, whether .app is a separate product, or whether it redirects to .com.

boardflight.com is a travel planning tool. It estimates when you should arrive at a US airport for a specific flight. You enter a flight number, and it returns one arrive-by time based on that airport's layout and security patterns for the hour you fly.
